description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/11/00163, Dated 30/10/2012 (Appeal Ref: APP/E5900/A/12/2175323)Non Material amendment(s) Sought:It is proposed to substitute some components with more robust and more properly positioned elements. These changes will represent minor amendments to the overall 2012 Planning Permission. It is proposed to replace the glass and stainless-steel balustrades in the public area that provides access between the two station ticket halls. It is proposed to complete the cladding of the ground floor of the CitizenM hotel, ensuring the lining can be located fully within the land owned by the hotel and be an appropriate extension of the existing designs. It is proposed to install additional lighting in the underside of the southern hotel canopy to enable a greater level of luminance across the width of the southern terrace, improving perceived and actual pedestrian safety.
